answer_2.quote: We first follow ... utilize the following four metrics for edit performance: (1) Success: the ratio of targeted knowledge achieving the top probability; (2) Locality: the ratio of related but non-identical facts kept intact by the edit; (3) Paraphrase (Para.): the ratio of targeted knowledge achieving success on paraphrased prompts; (4) Fluency: the weighted average of bi- and tri-gram entropies.
